appSubtitle: Local agent coordination and quota management
healthHint: Uses authenticated local CLI tools without API keys.
adviceText: Health checks send a short OK prompt only to enabled agents. Sign in using agy in your terminal, then enable Gemini by accepting the risk notice on its card.
geminiRisk: Some accounts using Antigravity CLI automation have reportedly been restricted by Google. Do you accept this risk to your Google account and enable Gemini?
usageHint: Usage indicator based on task count, not your subscription quota percentage.
promptPlaceholder:
What would you like us to do in this project?
For example: Review recent changes and find important bugs.
memoryHint: This short summary is included with new tasks. You can edit it anytime.
error_quota: This agent has reached a quota or rate limit.
solution_quota: Wait for quota renewal or use another enabled agent.
error_auth: The CLI is signed out or its login has expired.
solution_auth: Run `{command}` in your terminal and sign in again.
error_not_found: The CLI tool was not found.
solution_not_found: Install the CLI, add it to PATH and reopen the app.
error_other: The operation failed. See the raw output for details.
solution_other: Copy the raw output into a support request or GitHub issue.
emptyStream: No task has started yet. Send your first prompt or open a conversation from the sidebar.
clearHistoryConfirm: Permanently delete all sessions and project memories?
resumeHint: Your next prompt will be added to this session and resume its CLI session if available.
sessionNotSaved: Session finished; history saving is disabled.
privacyHint: History is stored only on this computer as JSON. Recognizable keys and tokens are masked before saving. When saving is off, sessions and automatic memory updates are not saved; manually saving memory still stores it.
modelHint: Each model needs an agent, name, level/cost and verified source. Preview models are not selected by default.
activityEmpty: No activity events were recorded for this session.
activityNoData: No data is available for this step yet.
activity_plan_created: Claude split the work into {count} tasks
activity_planning_failed: Claude could not create the plan
activity_model_changed: {agent}: switched to the CLI default model for {taskTitle}
activity_final_review_failed: Claude could not complete the final review
error_policy: The CLI tool policy denied access to this folder. The task was not completed.
solution_policy: Check the CLI access permissions for the selected working directory. Continue the session once access is available.
workspaceSubtitle: Describe a task. Let Claude plan and your agents work together.
chooseProjectHint: Open a project folder from the sidebar to get started.
projectUnavailable: The previous project could not be opened. Choose another folder.
projectContextHint: Sessions and memory stay linked to this folder.
memoryPlaceholder: What does the project do? Recent work and next steps…
coordinationHint: Claude plans and performs the final review. Models are selected for each task’s difficulty.
localHistoryHint: History stays on your device. Switching folders shows that project’s conversations.
timelinePlaceholder: Task steps appear here as they run. You can also open a past session.
